description: W4's English templates for everything that binds or reports a result (W4 sections 3.8.3, 3.8.5, 3.9.3, 3.10, 3.13.3; W3 section 3.9.2 for cancellation truth). The gateway renders these from structured data; the front model never words them. A persona may re-word a template through PersonaSpec.template_overrides, but the validator keeps every slot, its type and its order, refuses answer-lexicon phrases in question templates, refuses completion or cancellation wording outside the template's backing event, and runs the fact guard with no entity outside the persona's protected terms.

slot_types.w3_title: W3's speakable task label, a copy span of the caller's own words, sanitised, at most 80 characters
slot_types.verified_text: first-party text: the ActionProposal verb phrase or consequence, or background text that passed W3's outbound speech policy
slot_types.speak_value_list: the ActionProposal parameters in read-back order, each rendered by the SpeakValue rules below and joined with ', '
slot_types.closed_list: one value from the list given on the slot
slot_types.option_labels: HitlOption labels joined as 'A, B, or C'
slot_types.schema_label: a field label from the HitlRequest schema or a sensitive-category label
slot_types.channel_name: the operator's name for a secure or continuation channel, for example 'your screen' or 'a text message'
slot_types.verified_progress: a status fragment from a verified progress event; trusted entities only (W4 never-untrue table)
slot_types.effect_labels: W3 effect labels for committed effects, joined with ' and '
slot_types.action_label: W3's label for the side-effecting action, for example 'the booking'
slot_types.w3_title_list: W3 titles of the caller's requests, most recent first, joined with ', '

speak_value_rules.Code: one character at a time, separated by spaces ('U A 1 4 3 2')
speak_value_rules.Money: in words, with the currency word ('three hundred twelve dollars'; minor units as 'and N cents' when non-zero)
speak_value_rules.Date: weekday, month and ordinal day in words ('Friday, October ninth')
speak_value_rules.Time: clock form with AM or PM ('7:05 AM')
speak_value_rules.CardLast4: '<label> ending' then the four digits one at a time ('Visa ending 4 4 1 7')
speak_value_rules.Email: verbatim, never read for a sensitive request
speak_value_rules.Phone: digits one at a time in groups

answer_lexicon_for_validator.note: W4 section 3.8.6. The validator refuses these phrases in templates marked question: true (W4 section 3.13.1). W4 section 3.13.4 rule 2 says 'no template or bank line'; W4's own acknowledgement bank ('Sure, let me check.', 'Okay, one moment.') would fail that wider reading, so the reference applies the narrower one and flags the difference.

confirm.readback.source: W4 3.8.3; its own TTS chunk so the heard check ends at a clause boundary

confirm.question.text: Do you want me to do that?

confirm.weak_yes_reask.text: Just to be sure: do you want me to {verb_phrase}?

confirm.not_heard_reask.text: Okay, that's {params}. Do you want me to do that?
confirm.not_heard_reask.source: W4 3.8.3; 'Okay' opens a statement, the question clause carries no answer phrase

confirm.dtmf.text: You can also press 1 for yes, or 2 for no.
confirm.dtmf.source: Release 4 DTMF on SIP: said after the question to a caller on a phone line whose session takes keypad answers (hitl.channels dtmf)

confirm.other_voice.text: Here are the details from our system:
confirm.other_voice.source: W6 3.5.1: a gateway clip in a voice other than the provider's begins with this introduction, and the provider is told the system read the details in another voice

hitl.choose_dtmf.source: Release 4 DTMF on SIP: said after a choice to a caller on a phone line whose session takes keypad answers; key n picks option n

offer.result.text: I've got the answer on {task_title}. Want it now?

offer.more.text: There's more. Want me to go on?

update.offer_many.text: By the way, {count} updates are in: {task_titles}. Want them now?
update.offer_many.source: chapter 8: several updates at one slot become one offer

update.done.source: chapter 8: the narrator's fallback, the first sentence of the result

update.done_screen.text: Your {task_title} is done; the details are on your screen.
update.done_screen.source: chapter 8: the narrator's fallback when a screen is attached

update.screen.text: The details are on your screen.
update.screen.source: chapter 8: the end of a spoken update when a screen is attached

question.interrupt.source: chapter 8: a question with a deadline breaks into the agent's answer at a clause boundary

question.resume.source: chapter 8: the interrupted answer resumes from its first sentence the caller did not hear

question.expired.text: A question about {task_title} could not wait for your answer, so it went on without it.
question.expired.source: chapter 8: a deadline question nobody answered in time, said at the next slot

followup.undo_offer.text: Your {task_title} is already done. Do you want me to ask for it to be undone?
followup.undo_offer.source: chapter 8: cancelling something already done is a new compensating task, confirmed first

choice_offer.text: It's still going. Do you want to keep waiting, or should I {continuation_or_stop}?

status.queued.text: I'm still finishing {behind}; I'll do that next.

status.queued_on_create.text: I'll get to that right after {task_title}.
status.queued_on_create.source: W4 3.9.3 new request while W3 queues it

status.queued_behind.text: That's queued behind {count} other requests; I'll get to it after them.
status.queued_behind.source: chapter 8: work beyond a limit waits, and the caller hears it is queued

status.many.source: chapter 8: a status question is answered from the task tree

status.many_more.text: Right now I'm working on {task_titles}, and {count} more.
status.many_more.source: chapter 8: the three most recent requests by title, and how many more

status.waiting_on_caller.text: I'm waiting on your answer about {task_title}.
status.waiting_on_caller.source: reference addition: status of an input_required task (W2 legality keeps it out of the front's progress act)

status.result_ready.source: reference addition; W4 relays the result verbatim right after

presence.text: Yes, I'm here. I'm still working on {task_title}.

which_task.cancel.text: Which one should I stop: {task_a} or {task_b}?

duplicate.ask.text: Do you want me to change it, or is this a second one?
duplicate.ask.source: W3 3.4: a near-duplicate of a live or just-finished task; W4 asks instead of starting a silent second task

finish_or_stop.text: I'm still working on {task_title}. Do you want me to finish it, or stop it?

finish_or_stop.with_channel.text: I'm still working on {task_title}. Do you want me to finish it and {continuation_phrase}, or stop it?

goodbye.side_effect_running.text: Your {task_title} is still going through. Please stay on a moment so I can tell you how it went.

cancel.intent.source: W4 3.9.3: intent only, spoken at the abort; never a claim

cancel.confirmed_none_committed.truth: cancelled with nothing committed: the only template that may say stopped or cancelled without an effects clause

cancel.confirmed_committed.text: I've stopped it, but before it stopped it had already {effect_labels}.
cancel.confirmed_committed.truth: cancelled, but something was committed first

cancel.confirmed_effects_unknown.text: I've stopped it, but I can't confirm whether it had already {action_label}.

cancel.unconfirmed_backend_cannot_confir.text: I've told it to stop, but I can't confirm that it did.
cancel.unconfirmed_backend_cannot_confir.truth: cancel unconfirmed: the backend has no way to confirm

cancel.unconfirmed_no_confirmation_in_ti.text: I've asked it to stop; I'll let you know when it's confirmed.
cancel.unconfirmed_no_confirmation_in_ti.truth: cancel unconfirmed: no confirmation within cancel_confirm_timeout (10 s); a later Cancelled or Completed follows

cancel.unconfirmed_operation_in_flight.text: I stopped it, but {action_label} may already have gone through.
cancel.unconfirmed_operation_in_flight.truth: cancel unconfirmed: a write was running when the local stop happened

cancel.already_done.truth: already done: the task completed before the cancel took effect; the result is relayed verbatim right after

cancel.already_done_undo_offer.text: Do you want me to undo it?

stale_outcome.text: Before your change, {effect_labels} had already gone through.

unknown.text: I lost track of {task_title}; it may still have gone through.

failure.retryable.text: Sorry, I couldn't get that done just now.

failure.timeout.text: That's taking much longer than it should, so I've stopped it.

failure.effects_unknown.text: I'm not sure whether {verb_phrase} went through. I'll check before doing anything else.

failure.with_effects.text: It didn't finish, but it had already {effect_labels}.

rejected.text: That's not something I can do on this call.

approval_needed.text: That needs someone's approval first, so I haven't done it.
approval_needed.source: W4 3.10; the agent's approval_message wins when set

approval.not_recorded.text: Sorry, I couldn't record your approval.

approval.not_permitted.text: I can't approve that from this call. It needs sign-off from someone else first.

approval.more_needed.text: Thanks. It also needs sign-off from someone else before it can go ahead.

hitl.accept.source: W4 3.8.5: neutral; 'it's going ahead' only after W3 reports the run resumed

hitl.timeout.text: No problem, I'll hold off for now.

hitl.unclear_confirm.text: Sorry, was that a yes or a no?
hitl.unclear_confirm.source: W4 3.8.6 stage 3; names the answers on purpose; W4's echo guard keeps the agent's own words from parsing as an answer

sensitive.dtmf.text: For your security, please type {field_label} on your keypad, then press the pound key.

sensitive.screen.text: I'm putting a secure form on your screen for {field_label}.

sensitive.decline.text: I can't take {field_label} on this call for security reasons.
sensitive.decline.source: W4 3.8.7; the only path in Release 1

sensitive.dont_say.text: Please don't say that out loud. Use {channel} instead.

auth_url.before.text: To do that I need you to sign in. I'm sending a secure link to {channel}.

control.unsupported.text: Sorry, I can't {what} on this line.
control.unsupported.source: chapter 9: a control the session cannot apply, said honestly

control.refused.text: Sorry, that's something I'm not allowed to change here.
control.refused.source: chapter 9: a control the operator does not allow

control.language_unsupported.text: Sorry, I can only speak {languages} on this line.
control.language_unsupported.source: chapter 9: a language without a recogniser, a voice or a reviewed pack

control.language_answers_only.text: Okay, I'll answer in {language}. A few of my own short lines may stay in English.

control.nothing_to_repeat.text: Sorry, I don't have that to say again.
control.nothing_to_repeat.source: chapter 9: repeat, spell or to_screen with nothing heard to take it from

control.voice_changed.text: Okay, I'll speak in this voice now.
control.voice_changed.source: chapter 9: voice, in the new voice

control.human_transfer.text: Of course, I'm putting you through to a person now.
control.human_transfer.source: chapter 9: human, before the operator's transfer

control.human_unavailable.text: Sorry, there's no one I can put you through to on this line.
control.human_unavailable.source: chapter 9: human without a transfer configured

control.human_finding.text: Of course, I'm finding a person for you. One moment.
control.human_finding.source: chapter 9: human, while the operator finds a person

control.human_no_answer.text: Sorry, nobody can take your call right now, but I am still here to help.
control.human_no_answer.source: chapter 9: human, the operator found no one

repeat_request.text: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it again?

regime_c_correction.text: Just to be clear, that isn't finished yet. I'll tell you when it is.
